newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Clark in top place after viewers poll - paper.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Clark in top place after viewers poll - paper.

text.p: Labour leader Helen Clark retained her top spot in the TVNZ leaders' debate on Monday, according to the New Zealand Herald's independent polling carried out after the debate.
In a poll of 205 voters conducted by Waikato University, Clark improved on her first debate performance, rating best with nearly half those polled, the Herald said on Tuesday.
"Mr Bolger again failed to impress viewers," the paper said. "Half the people surveyed thought he was the worst performer of the night. He was again judged the third best performer."
New Zealand First Leader Winston Peters improved on his first debate performance, moving from last place to second and exchanging places with the Alliance Leader Jim Anderton.
Asked which leader performed the best, 49.2 percent said Clark, 18.5 percent said Peters, 16.4 percent said Bolger and 13.2 percent said Anderton.
Asked which leader performed the worst, 50.3 percent said Bolger, 19.1 percent said Anderton, 19.1 percent said Peters and 6.0 percent said Clark. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
